- Volume ≈ 156 × 1.2 ≈ 190 ml. Bulk density for chopped vegetables is 0.6 g/ml, so mass ≈ 115 g. Round to about 120 g.

**STEP 4 - Hidden food:** No base layer is visible. The carrots sit on the plate surface and there is no sauce or hidden layer to add.

**STEP 5 - Energy:** Boiled carrots are about 35 kcal per 100 g, so 120 g ≈ 42 kcal.
